activity_summary: You ate before church at the lodging. The loaf was shrunk on the pan, and it was still a penny. You told Mistress Ansell you would be out at noon, at the Fields', with the shop shut.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, and said he would be at the Fields' at noon.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Stopped any talk of the price, and told him to be in before dark.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Put the butter by his elbow.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Cut his bread no smaller than yesterday, and asked to sit at the back of the church.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in Bread before the bell

facets.activity: Ate before church and said dinner was at the Fields'

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Eat before the bell. The loaf is shrunk on the pan, the price is a penny, and I will hear no speech on it.
